planets.name: WASP-19 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Wattle with a 0.789-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-19 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Wattle. Its orbit and size follow Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CORT_EACUTE_S_ZULETA_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 0.78883900702, pl_radj 1.415, pl_bmassj 1.154

quotes.title: WASP-19b
quotes.card: WASP-19b, formally named Banksia, is an exoplanet, notable for possessing one of the shortest orbital periods of any known planetary body: 0.79 days or approximately 18.932 hours.
quotes.introduction: It has a mass close to that of Jupiter, but by comparison has a much larger radius ; making it nearly the size of a low-mass star.
